test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The National Anti-Doping Bill, 2021, passed by the Lok Sabha in July 2022, provides for creating a statutory framework for which of the following agencies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA)**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Anti-Doping Bill, 2021 was approved in the Lok Sabha by voice vote on Wednesday, **July 27, 2022.**
 
• The** National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) **and the National Dope Testing Laboratory in Sports are to be given a legal framework by the proposed law.
 
• Anti-doping rule violations were planned, implemented, and monitored by this organization.
 
• It also aims to comply with other commitments and obligations, such as the International Convention against Doping in Sports, established by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.
 
• The law prohibits doping in sports by competitors, athlete support staff and other individuals. According to the new law, breaking anti-doping laws can result in disqualification, loss of medals, points and awards, time limits on participation in a competition or event, and financial penalties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Anti-Doping Agency** of India is the country's national body in charge of leading, directing and supervising the doping control program in all forms of sports.
 
• The **World Anti-Doping Agency's rules** and policies are adopted and put into practice by the Agency, which also cooperates with other anti-doping organizations and supports anti-doping research and education. All this is stated on the official website of the agency.
 
• The agency established by the Central Government under the **Societies Registration** Act comprises scientists and representatives of the Indian Olympic Association.
